properties.description: Canalización para validar la conexión y consultar los registros del Data Warehouse hospitalario.

scripts.text:
SELECT 'BRONZE - PACIENTES' AS Tabla, COUNT(*) AS Registros
FROM bronze.patients

UNION ALL

SELECT 'BRONZE - ADMISIONES', COUNT(*)
FROM bronze.admissions

UNION ALL

SELECT 'BRONZE - DIAGNOSTICOS', COUNT(*)
FROM bronze.diagnoses

UNION ALL

SELECT 'BRONZE - FACTURACION', COUNT(*)
FROM bronze.billing

UNION ALL

SELECT 'SILVER - PACIENTES', COUNT(*)
FROM silver.patients

UNION ALL

SELECT 'SILVER - ADMISIONES', COUNT(*)
FROM silver.admissions

UNION ALL

SELECT 'SILVER - DIAGNOSTICOS', COUNT(*)
FROM silver.diagnoses

UNION ALL

SELECT 'SILVER - FACTURACION', COUNT(*)
FROM silver.billing;
